verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships its own software product, Visalaw AI, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack only says Visalaw AI is SOC 2 Type II certified with "no data retention". That is a related data-handling posture, not a documented user control to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. No evidence shows such a setting exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
